subject: Post-discovery: schedule 60-90m ML/Infra deep dive & success criteria
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha@clearwell.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: schedule 60-90m ML/Infra deep dive & success criteria

Hi Samantha / David —

Thanks again for the call earlier — helpful to hear Clearwell’s priority to reduce inference latency for triage suggestions and to centralize embeddings for your search index. Next step from our side is a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with our ML infra leads so we can:

- Validate current data flows (PII handling + retention)
- Share performance targets + benchmarks for similar workloads
- Walk through deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and control plane needs
- Draft a short runbook for rollout blockers and fallbacks

Propose three windows (all PT):
- Tue 25 May, 9:30–11:00
- Wed 26 May, 12:00–13:30
- Thu 27 May, 16:00–17:30

Please pick which one works (or propose alternatives). Internal attendees we plan to include: me (solutions lead), Marissa (ML infra lead), Neha (solutions engineer — pricing/SLAs). If you want any specific Clearwell engineers to join (platform, security, or data infra), flag them and we’ll invite.

I attached a short risk checklist and a draft mutual action plan to help orient the meeting. If you have specific queries (e.g., encryption at rest keys, SOC2 evidence, or preferred quantization targets), drop them here so we can prioritize.

Thanks,

Marcus Lin
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: clearwell-risksheet.pdf (1 page), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (stub)

From: Samantha Green <samantha@clearwell.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: David Ortiz <david.ortiz@clearwell.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule 60-90m ML/Infra deep dive & success criteria

Thanks Marcus — good recap.

We can do Wed 26 May, 12:00–13:30 PT. David (cc’d) will join from our platform team. Could you confirm who from Redwood will present the latency benchmarks and who will own the runbook section? We’d like to make sure our platform lead and a data engineer can attend.

A couple of asks before the deep dive:
- Can you surface any existing perf numbers for 2k token prompts on an Llama-variant (p99, median)?
- High-level expected token cost delta between hosted + ded (docs suffice)
- Any security pre-reads for our security engineer (SOC2 mapping or compliance attestations)

On the attendee side: I’ll bring David Ortiz (platform), and I’ll try to invite Nisha Patel (data eng) — she’s still confirming.

Appreciate it — Sam

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule 60-90m ML/Infra deep dive & success criteria

Great — locking Wed 26 May, 12:00–13:30 PT. Marcus, I’ll own the latency/benchmark section and bring a short slide with p50/p95/p99 numbers for the 2k-token range across:

- Redwood-hosted (vCPU + GPU baseline)
- Dedicated (reserved GPU pool)
- Quantized variants (4-bit/8-bit)

Neha will cover the SLAs, canary rollout pattern, and cost levers (batching, cache TTLs).

Agenda (draft, 60–75 min):
1) 5m — Introductions & objectives (Marcus)
2) 15m — Current Clearwell data/infra assumptions (Samantha/David)
3) 25m — Performance profile + deployment options (Marissa)
4) 10m — Cost and rollout controls (Neha)
5) 10m — Runbook & next steps / Q&A

I attached a short mutual-action-plan with owners filled for the first pass. Samantha — can you confirm David and Nisha (if she joins) are ok with the agenda? Also let us know any security pre-reads you want up front and we’ll share SOC2 mapping and a short KMS integration note prior to the call.

Marissa Cole
ML Infrastructure Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Perfect — calendar invite sent for Wed, 26 May, 12:00–13:30 PT (invite includes Zoom link).

Quick notes / pre-reads we’ll upload by end of day Monday:
- Marissa: p50/p95/p99 numbers for 2k tokens on our reference Llama-variant (spreadsheet + short write-up)
- Security: SOC2 mapping doc + KMS integration summary
- Cost: short slide with expected token-cost delta (hosted vs dedicated) and sample unit economics for your estimated monthly usage

Action items (owners):
- Clearwell: confirm whether Nisha will join (Samantha)
- Redwood: provide pre-reads and runbook template (Marissa / Neha)
- Both: add any extra participants to the invite before EOD Monday

If anything changes to stakeholders or goals, reply-all and we’ll adjust the agenda. Looking forward to it.

Thanks,

Marcus Lin
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
